breaking: groups are <details>/<summary> instead of a button with aria-expanded; defaultCollapsed renders them closed
each row is one grid line with a sticky name cell instead of two separate columns
tick labels are thinned for minTimelineWidth instead of the measured width (no ResizeObserver)
only now="auto" uses the client island (799 B gzip); a pinned now is drawn on the server
lucide-react removed, chevron is an inline SVG
new file gantt-chart.client.tsx must be added to registry.json
